create_NLTKTokenizer: create an NLTKTokenizer instance to tokenize text using NLTK word_tokenize
encode_NLTKTokenizer: encode a string into space-separated tokens using NLTKTokenizer encode method
decode_NLTKTokenizer: decode tokenized text back to a string using NLTKTokenizer decode method
register_nltk_tokenizer: register the NLTK tokenizer with fairseq using the register_tokenizer decorator
review_NLTKTokenizer_class: review the NLTKTokenizer class and its encode decode methods for text tokenization
